purpose: Verify spelled-out navigation arrival estimates and original-request summary routing with actual RTC navigation/correction; retain all effects, content, timing, traces and cleanup.
hypotheses: Successful direct replies use spelled-out estimates while preserving destination/replacement/duration facts.
Corrections still interrupt earlier result speech, complete the office result, and clean up their rooms.

correction.final_input: Actually, go to the office instead.

method: Reuse exact existing WAVs and local model/driver settings; one shared stack, four serial fresh rooms, no exclusions. Previous iteration8 RTC is historical context, not a controlled latency comparison.
No source or configuration changes during a live suite; retain failed captures and all tool/error/runtime logs.
After each client exits, inspect only its owned room for agent presence for up to10seconds; do not delete the room to create apparent job cleanup.
Send worker SIGTERM after all trials and departure checks. Keep original20second outer grace and record any escalation separately from capture success.
Keep all raw trace equality failures, classifying initial-event omission and any events emitted after client disconnect separately.
Review full received audio through pinned local ASR after timed capture and owned-stack cleanup. This is an ASR proxy, not human listening.
limitations: Four serial repeated synthetic development captures validate integration, not a controlled RTC latency improvement, general accuracy, microphone/echo behavior or capacity.
No injected slow logger in these live cases; ordinary compute_route delay remains. Controlled loop fault injection is separate iteration6 evidence.
Capture completion, tool effects, full trace equality, received content, caller cleanup, room-job departure and process exit are separate checks.
Input/frame/data transport timestamps do not establish physical audible timing. Default ICE/STUN may use network services although all model inference is local.
Existing recorder may omit the initial listening event; its receiver shutdown does not prove every transmitted frame arrived.
These pure navigation/correction captures do not test a resolver that drops an extra information request; that boundary has separate scripted integration tests.
